summary: Townsville-based accounting, tax and advisory firm (est. 1918, independent of PwC since 2017) with offices in Townsville, Cairns, Innisfail and Darwin and a team of over 80. Greg Peel is a founding partner. The firm sells virtual CFO and advanced bookkeeping across Xero, MYOB and QBO, is hiring Senior Consultants and is growing its Darwin office. Already emailed once on 23 Nov 2026; two follow-ups drafted.
